title: Breaking an ester with water
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Acid-catalyzed hydrolysis of methyl ethanoate forms ethanoic acid and methanol. The displayed acid is the acyl-derived product; the reaction is reversible.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of methyl ethanoate under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Methyl ethanoate is treated with aqueous acid and heat. Which major organic product forms after workup? Acid-catalyzed hydrolysis of methyl ethanoate forms ethanoic acid and methanol. The displayed acid is the acyl-derived product; the reaction is reversible.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
